```python name=00_theory/06_langchain_metadata_filtering.py
"""
CHAPTER 6: Metadata Filtering with LangChain + ChromaDB

ChromaDB uses the SAME where-operator syntax inside LangChain's `filter` param.
  filter={"field": value}                  → equality
  filter={"field": {"$op": value}}         → comparison
  filter={"$and": [...]}                   → logical AND
  filter={"$or": [...]}                    → logical OR
"""

import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document

load_dotenv()
embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-large", api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

# ── Seed dataset ──────────────────────────────────
RESEARCH_DOCS = [
    Document(page_content="Attention mechanisms allow transformers to focus on relevant tokens.", metadata={"author": "vaswani", "year": 2017, "domain": "nlp", "cited_by": 80000, "journal": "NeurIPS"}),
    Document(page_content="BERT achieves state-of-the-art on many NLP benchmarks via pre-training.", metadata={"author": "devlin", "year": 2019, "domain": "nlp", "cited_by": 60000, "journal": "NAACL"}),
    Document(page_content="GPT-3 demonstrates few-shot learning at scale with 175B parameters.", metadata={"author": "brown", "year": 2020, "domain": "llm", "cited_by": 35000, "journal": "NeurIPS"}),
    Document(page_content="Diffusion models surpass GANs on image synthesis quality.", metadata={"author": "ho", "year": 2020, "domain": "cv", "cited_by": 15000, "journal": "NeurIPS"}),
    Document(page_content="Vision Transformers apply transformer architecture to image patches.", metadata={"author": "dosovitskiy", "year": 2021, "domain": "cv", "cited_by": 25000, "journal": "ICLR"}),
    Document(page_content="Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning in large language models.", metadata={"author": "wei", "year": 2022, "domain": "llm", "cited_by": 5000, "journal": "NeurIPS"}),
    Document(page_content="RLHF aligns language models with human preferences via reward models.", metadata={"author": "ouyang", "year": 2022, "domain": "llm", "cited_by": 8000, "journal": "NeurIPS"}),
    Document(page_content="LLaMA provides open-source large language models at multiple scales.", metadata={"author": "touvron", "year": 2023, "domain": "llm", "cited_by": 12000, "journal": "arXiv"}),
    Document(page_content="RAG retrieves external knowledge to reduce LLM hallucinations.", metadata={"author": "lewis", "year": 2020, "domain": "rag", "cited_by": 7000, "journal": "NeurIPS"}),
    Document(page_content="Mixture of Experts scales LLMs efficiently with sparse activation.", metadata={"author": "fedus", "year": 2022, "domain": "llm", "cited_by": 3000, "journal": "JMLR"}),
    Document(page_content="Self-supervised learning learns representations without labels.", metadata={"author": "lecun", "year": 2021, "domain": "ml", "cited_by": 4000, "journal": "Nature"}),
    Document(page_content="Contrastive learning creates embeddings by comparing positive/negative pairs.", metadata={"author": "chen", "year": 2020, "domain": "ml", "cited_by": 18000, "journal": "ICML"}),
]

vs = Chroma.from_documents(
    RESEARCH_DOCS,
    embedding=embeddings,
    collection_name="research_papers",
    collection_metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
)
print(f"✅ Seeded {vs._collection.count()} research papers\n")

def show(title, results, show_meta=True):
    print(f"\n  ▶ {title} ({len(results)} results):")
    if not results:
        print("    ⚠️  No results")
        return
    for i, d in enumerate(results, 1):
        meta_str = f"year={d.metadata.get('year')} domain={d.metadata.get('domain')} cited={d.metadata.get('cited_by')}" if show_meta else ""
        print(f"    [{i}] {d.page_content[:65]}")
        if show_meta:
            print(f"         {meta_str}")

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXAMPLE 1: Filtering Research Papers
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("=" * 60)
print("EXAMPLE 1: Research Paper Filters")
print("=" * 60)

show("domain == 'nlp'",
    vs.similarity_search("language understanding", k=3, filter={"domain": "nlp"}))

show("year >= 2022",
    vs.similarity_search("modern AI", k=4, filter={"year": {"$gte": 2022}}))

show("cited_by > 10000 (highly cited)",
    vs.similarity_search("influential papers", k=4, filter={"cited_by": {"$gt": 10000}}))

show("journal == 'NeurIPS'",
    vs.similarity_search("deep learning", k=4, filter={"journal": "NeurIPS"}))

show("domain in ['llm', 'rag']",
    vs.similarity_search("language models", k=4, filter={"domain": {"$in": ["llm", "rag"]}}))

show("year>=2021 AND cited_by>5000",
    vs.similarity_search("recent breakthrough", k=3, filter={
        "$and": [
            {"year": {"$gte": 2021}},
            {"cited_by": {"$gt": 5000}},
        ]
    }))

show("domain=='cv' OR domain=='nlp'",
    vs.similarity_search("vision and language", k=4, filter={
        "$or": [
            {"domain": "cv"},
            {"domain": "nlp"},
        ]
    }))

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXAMPLE 2: E-commerce Product Catalog
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("EXAMPLE 2: E-commerce Product Catalog")
print("=" * 60)

PRODUCTS = [
    Document(page_content="Apple iPhone 15 Pro with titanium frame and A17 chip.", metadata={"brand": "apple", "category": "smartphone", "price": 999, "in_stock": True, "rating": 4.8}),
    Document(page_content="Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra with S Pen and 200MP camera.", metadata={"brand": "samsung", "category": "smartphone", "price": 1199, "in_stock": True, "rating": 4.7}),
    Document(page_content="Google Pixel 8 with Tensor G3 chip and AI photography.", metadata={"brand": "google", "category": "smartphone", "price": 699, "in_stock": False, "rating": 4.6}),
    Document(page_content="MacBook Pro M3 with 18-hour battery and Retina display.", metadata={"brand": "apple", "category": "laptop", "price": 1999, "in_stock": True, "rating": 4.9}),
    Document(page_content="Dell XPS 15 with OLED display and Intel Core i9.", metadata={"brand": "dell", "category": "laptop", "price": 1599, "in_stock": True, "rating": 4.5}),
    Document(page_content="Sony WH-1000XM5 wireless noise-cancelling headphones.", metadata={"brand": "sony", "category": "headphones", "price": 349, "in_stock": True, "rating": 4.8}),
    Document(page_content="Apple AirPods Pro 2 with adaptive transparency mode.", metadata={"brand": "apple", "category": "headphones", "price": 249, "in_stock": True, "rating": 4.7}),
    Document(page_content="Samsung 65-inch QLED 4K Smart TV with Neo Quantum processor.", metadata={"brand": "samsung", "category": "tv", "price": 1299, "in_stock": False, "rating": 4.6}),
]

vs2 = Chroma.from_documents(
    PRODUCTS, embedding=embeddings, collection_name="products",
    collection_metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
)

show("category=='smartphone' AND in_stock==True",
    vs2.similarity_search("best phone", k=3, filter={
        "$and": [{"category": "smartphone"}, {"in_stock": True}]
    }))

show("price < 500 (budget options)",
    vs2.similarity_search("affordable tech", k=3, filter={"price": {"$lt": 500}}))

show("brand=='apple' AND rating>=4.7",
    vs2.similarity_search("Apple premium products", k=3, filter={
        "$and": [{"brand": "apple"}, {"rating": {"$gte": 4.7}}]
    }))

show("price between 200–800 ($in doesn't apply; use $and)",
    vs2.similarity_search("mid-range electronics", k=4, filter={
        "$and": [{"price": {"$gte": 200}}, {"price": {"$lte": 800}}]
    }))

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXAMPLE 3: Retriever with Metadata Filter in Chains
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("EXAMPLE 3: Retriever + Metadata Filter for RAG Chains")
print("=" * 60)

# LangChain retriever with built-in metadata filter
retriever_nlp = vs.as_retriever(
    search_type="similarity",
    search_kwargs={
        "k": 3,
        "filter": {"domain": "nlp"},
    },
)
docs = retriever_nlp.invoke("how do language models work?")
show("Retriever with domain='nlp' filter", docs)

# MMR retriever with filter
retriever_mmr_llm = vs.as_retriever(
    search_type="mmr",
    search_kwargs={
        "k": 3,
        "fetch_k": 8,
        "lambda_mult": 0.6,
        "filter": {"domain": "llm"},
    },
)
docs = retriever_mmr_llm.invoke("scaling language models")
show("MMR Retriever with domain='llm' filter", docs)

# Score threshold retriever with filter
retriever_threshold = vs.as_retriever(
    search_type="similarity_score_threshold",
    search_kwargs={
        "score_threshold": 0.70,
        "k": 5,
        "filter": {"year": {"$gte": 2020}},
    },
)
docs = retriever_threshold.invoke("recent AI advances")
show("Threshold Retriever with year>=2020 filter", docs)
```

```python name=project-1-knowledge-base/knowledge_base.py
"""
KnowledgeBase: Full CRUD wrapper around LangChain + ChromaDB.
Covers:
  - save documents (from_documents / add_documents)
  - delete by ID
  - update by ID (delete + re-add, merge metadata)
  - get by ID
  - list all
  - load persisted DB
  - basic similarity search
  - search with scores
"""

import os
import uuid
import json
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document

load_dotenv()

CHROMA_DB_PATH = "./chroma_db/knowledge_base"
COLLECTION_NAME = "knowledge_base"

embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings(
    model="text-embedding-3-large",
    api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

class KnowledgeBase:
    """
    A persistent knowledge base backed by ChromaDB + OpenAI Embeddings.
    All operations auto-persist to disk.
    """

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = CHROMA_DB_PATH, collection_name: str = COLLECTION_NAME):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.collection_name = collection_name
        self._vs: Optional[Chroma] = None

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # Internal: get or create vector store
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    @property
    def vs(self) -> Chroma:
        if self._vs is None:
            self._vs = Chroma(
                collection_name=self.collection_name,
                embedding_function=embeddings,
                persist_directory=self.db_path,
                collection_metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
            )
        return self._vs

    def count(self) -> int:
        return self.vs._collection.count()

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 1. SAVE (Add) Documents
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def save_documents(self, documents: list[Document]) -> list[str]:
        """
        Save a list of documents into ChromaDB.
        Auto-assigns UUID if doc has no id.
        Auto-stamps 'created_at' metadata.
        Returns the list of IDs stored.
        """
        now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        ids = []
        for doc in documents:
            if not doc.id:
                doc.id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            doc.metadata.setdefault("created_at", now)
            ids.append(doc.id)

        self.vs.add_documents(documents=documents, ids=ids)
        print(f"➕ Saved {len(documents)} documents | IDs: {ids}")
        return ids

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 2. GET Document by ID
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def get_by_id(self, doc_id: str) -> Optional[Document]:
        """Fetch a document by its ID."""
        result = self.vs._collection.get(ids=[doc_id], include=["documents", "metadatas"])
        if not result["ids"]:
            print(f"⚠️  No document with ID '{doc_id}'")
            return None
        return Document(
            id=result["ids"][0],
            page_content=result["documents"][0],
            metadata=result["metadatas"][0],
        )

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3. DELETE by ID
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def delete_by_id(self, ids: list[str]) -> None:
        """Delete one or more documents by ID."""
        self.vs.delete(ids=ids)
        print(f"🗑️  Deleted IDs: {ids} | Remaining: {self.count()}")

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 4. UPDATE by ID
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def update_by_id(
        self,
        doc_id: str,
        new_content: Optional[str] = None,
        new_metadata: Optional[dict] = None,
        merge_metadata: bool = True,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Update a document's content and/or metadata.
        Uses delete + re-add strategy to refresh the embedding.
        merge_metadata=True → merges new_metadata into existing metadata.
        """
        existing = self.get_by_id(doc_id)
        if not existing:
            return False

        content = new_content or existing.page_content

        if merge_metadata and new_metadata:
            meta = {**existing.metadata, **new_metadata}
        else:
            meta = new_metadata or existing.metadata

        meta["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

        # Delete old embedding + re-add with fresh embedding
        self.vs.delete(ids=[doc_id])
        updated_doc = Document(id=doc_id, page_content=content, metadata=meta)
        self.vs.add_documents(documents=[updated_doc], ids=[doc_id])
        print(f"✏️  Updated '{doc_id}' | content_changed={new_content is not None}")
        return True

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 5. DELETE by Metadata (Bulk)
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def delete_by_metadata(self, filter_key: str, filter_value) -> list[str]:
        """Delete all documents matching a metadata filter."""
        results = self.vs._collection.get(
            where={filter_key: {"$eq": filter_value}},
            include=[],
        )
        ids = results["ids"]
        if ids:
            self.vs.delete(ids=ids)
            print(f"🗑️  Bulk deleted {len(ids)} docs where {filter_key}='{filter_value}'")
        else:
            print(f"ℹ️  No docs found where {filter_key}='{filter_value}'")
        return ids

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 6. LIST ALL Documents
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def list_all(self) -> list[Document]:
        """Return all documents in the collection."""
        result = self.vs._collection.get(include=["documents", "metadatas"])
        docs = []
        for doc_id, content, meta in zip(result["ids"], result["documents"], result["metadatas"]):
            docs.append(Document(id=doc_id, page_content=content, metadata=meta))
        return docs

    def print_all(self) -> None:
        docs = self.list_all()
        print(f"\n📋 All Documents ({len(docs)} total):")
        print("-" * 60)
        for doc in docs:
            print(f"  ID      : {doc.id}")
            print(f"  Content : {doc.page_content[:80]}")
            print(f"  Metadata: {json.dumps(doc.metadata, indent=12, default=str)}")
            print()

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # 7. SEARCH
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def search(self, query: str, k: int = 4, filter: dict = None) -> list[Document]:
        """Basic similarity search with optional metadata filter."""
        kwargs = {"query": query, "k": k}
        if filter:
            kwargs["filter"] = filter
        results = self.vs.similarity_search(**kwargs)
        print(f"\n🔍 Search: '{query}' | filter={filter}")
        for i, d in enumerate(results, 1):
            print(f"  [{i}] {d.id} | {d.page_content[:70]}")
            print(f"       meta: {d.metadata}")
        return results

    def search_with_scores(self, query: str, k: int = 4, filter: dict = None) -> list[tuple[Document, float]]:
        """Similarity search returning (Document, relevance_score) — 0 to 1."""
        kwargs = {"query": query, "k": k}
        if filter:
            kwargs["filter"] = filter
        results = self.vs.similarity_search_with_relevance_scores(**kwargs)
        print(f"\n📊 Scored Search: '{query}' | filter={filter}")
        for i, (d, score) in enumerate(results, 1):
            print(f"  [{i}] relevance={score:.4f} | {d.page_content[:60]}")
        return results
```

```python name=project-2-multi-collection/collection_manager.py
"""
CollectionManager: Manage multiple ChromaDB collections,
each representing a different domain/namespace.
"""

import os
from typing import Optional
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document
import chromadb

load_dotenv()

CHROMA_DB_PATH = "./chroma_db/multi_collection"

embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings(
    model="text-embedding-3-large",
    api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

class CollectionManager:
    """Manage multiple named ChromaDB collections under one persist directory."""

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = CHROMA_DB_PATH):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._stores: dict[str, Chroma] = {}
        # Shared persistent client
        self._client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=db_path)

    def get_store(self, collection_name: str) -> Chroma:
        """Get or create a LangChain Chroma store for a collection."""
        if collection_name not in self._stores:
            self._stores[collection_name] = Chroma(
                client=self._client,
                collection_name=collection_name,
                embedding_function=embeddings,
                collection_metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
            )
        return self._stores[collection_name]

    def list_collections(self) -> list[str]:
        return [c.name for c in self._client.list_collections()]

    def add_documents(self, collection_name: str, documents: list[Document], ids: list[str] = None) -> list[str]:
        store = self.get_store(collection_name)
        if ids:
            assigned_ids = store.add_documents(documents=documents, ids=ids)
        else:
            assigned_ids = store.add_documents(documents=documents)
        print(f"➕ [{collection_name}] Added {len(documents)} docs")
        return assigned_ids

    def search(self, collection_name: str, query: str, k: int = 3, filter: dict = None, search_type: str = "similarity") -> list:
        store = self.get_store(collection_name)
        kwargs = {"k": k}
        if filter:
            kwargs["filter"] = filter

        if search_type == "similarity":
            results = store.similarity_search(query=query, **kwargs)
        elif search_type == "mmr":
            kwargs["fetch_k"] = k * 3
            results = store.max_marginal_relevance_search(query=query, **kwargs)
        elif search_type == "with_score":
            results = store.similarity_search_with_relevance_scores(query=query, **kwargs)
        else:
            results = store.similarity_search(query=query, **kwargs)

        return results

    def cross_collection_search(self, query: str, collections: list[str], k_per_col: int = 2) -> dict[str, list[Document]]:
        """Search across multiple collections and return results grouped by collection."""
        all_results = {}
        for col in collections:
            results = self.search(col, query, k=k_per_col)
            all_results[col] = results
        return all_results

    def delete_collection(self, collection_name: str) -> None:
        self._client.delete_collection(collection_name)
        self._stores.pop(collection_name, None)
        print(f"🗑️  Deleted collection: {collection_name}")

    def stats(self) -> None:
        print("\n📊 Collection Stats:")
        for col in self.list_collections():
            count = self._client.get_collection(col).count()
            print(f"  {col}: {count} documents")
```

```python name=project-2-multi-collection/search_showcase.py
"""
All 7 search types demonstrated on ChromaDB collections.
"""

from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings

def run_all_search_types(vs: Chroma, embeddings: OpenAIEmbeddings, query: str):
    print(f"\n{'█'*60}")
    print(f"  QUERY: '{query}'")
    print(f"{'█'*60}")

    # ── Type 1: Basic Similarity ─────────────────────────
    print("\n[Type 1] similarity_search:")
    results = vs.similarity_search(query=query, k=3)
    for i, d in enumerate(results, 1):
        print(f"  [{i}] {d.page_content[:70]}")

    # ── Type 2: With Raw Distance Score ──────────────────
    print("\n[Type 2] similarity_search_with_score (raw distance):")

    # ── Type 7: Retriever (MMR) ───────────────────────────
```

```python name=project-3-rag-pipeline/document_store.py
"""
DocumentStore: Full document lifecycle management with rich metadata.
"""

import os
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional, Callable
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document
import chromadb

load_dotenv()

CHROMA_DB_PATH = "./chroma_db/rag_pipeline"
COLLECTION_NAME = "rag_documents"

embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings(
    model="text-embedding-3-large",
    api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

class DocumentStore:
    """
    Production-grade document store with:
    - Full CRUD
    - Rich metadata support
    - All ChromaDB filter operators
    - Multiple search strategies
    - Retriever factory methods
    """

    def __init__(self, db_path=CHROMA_DB_PATH, collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.collection_name = collection_name
        self._client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=db_path)
        self._vs = Chroma(
            client=self._client,
            collection_name=collection_name,
            embedding_function=embeddings,
            collection_metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
        )

    @property
    def vs(self) -> Chroma:
        return self._vs

    def count(self) -> int:
        return self._vs._collection.count()

    # ─── CRUD ────────────────────────────────────────
    def add(self, documents: list[Document], ids: list[str] = None) -> list[str]:
        now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        final_ids = []
        for i, doc in enumerate(documents):
            doc_id = (ids[i] if ids else None) or doc.id or str(uuid.uuid4())
            doc.id = doc_id
            doc.metadata.setdefault("created_at", now)
            final_ids.append(doc_id)
        self._vs.add_documents(documents=documents, ids=final_ids)
        print(f"➕ Added {len(documents)} docs | IDs: {final_ids}")
        return final_ids

    def get(self, doc_id: str) -> Optional[Document]:
        r = self._vs._collection.get(ids=[doc_id], include=["documents", "metadatas"])
        if not r["ids"]:
            return None
        return Document(id=r["ids"][0], page_content=r["documents"][0], metadata=r["metadatas"][0])

    def delete(self, ids: list[str]) -> None:
        self._vs.delete(ids=ids)
        print(f"🗑️  Deleted: {ids}")

    def delete_where(self, where: dict) -> list[str]:
        r = self._vs._collection.get(where=where, include=[])
        ids = r["ids"]
        if ids:
            self._vs.delete(ids=ids)
            print(f"🗑️  Deleted {len(ids)} docs matching {where}")
        return ids

    def update(self, doc_id: str, content: str = None, metadata: dict = None, merge: bool = True) -> bool:
        existing = self.get(doc_id)
        if not existing:
            print(f"⚠️  Not found: {doc_id}")
            return False
        new_content = content or existing.page_content
        if merge and metadata:
            new_meta = {**existing.metadata, **metadata, "updated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}
        else:
            new_meta = metadata or existing.metadata
            new_meta["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self._vs.delete(ids=[doc_id])
        self._vs.add_documents([Document(id=doc_id, page_content=new_content, metadata=new_meta)], ids=[doc_id])
        print(f"✏️  Updated: {doc_id}")
        return True

    def upsert(self, doc_id: str, content: str, metadata: dict) -> None:
        """Insert if not exists, update if exists."""
        existing = self.get(doc_id)
        if existing:
            self.update(doc_id, content, metadata, merge=False)
        else:
            self.add([Document(id=doc_id, page_content=content, metadata=metadata)], ids=[doc_id])

    # ─── Search Methods ───────────────────────────────
    def search(self, query: str, k: int = 4, filter: dict = None) -> list[Document]:
        kwargs = {"query": query, "k": k}
        if filter:
            kwargs["filter"] = filter
        return self._vs.similarity_search(**kwargs)

    def search_with_scores(self, query: str, k: int = 4, filter: dict = None) -> list[tuple[Document, float]]:
        kwargs = {"query": query, "k": k}
        if filter:
            kwargs["filter"] = filter
        return self._vs.similarity_search_with_relevance_scores(**kwargs)

    def search_mmr(self, query: str, k: int = 4, fetch_k: int = 12, lambda_mult: float = 0.5, filter: dict = None) -> list[Document]:
        kwargs = {"query": query, "k": k, "fetch_k": fetch_k, "lambda_mult": lambda_mult}
        if filter:
            kwargs["filter"] = filter
        return self._vs.max_marginal_relevance_search(**kwargs)

    def get_retriever(self, search_type: str = "similarity", k: int = 4, filter: dict = None, **kwargs):
        """
        Factory: get a LangChain retriever.
        search_type: 'similarity' | 'mmr' | 'similarity_score_threshold'
        """
        search_kwargs = {"k": k, **kwargs}
        if filter:
            search_kwargs["filter"] = filter
        return self._vs.as_retriever(search_type=search_type, search_kwargs=search_kwargs)

    # ─── Listing ──────────────────────────────────────
    def list_by_filter(self, where: dict) -> list[Document]:
        r = self._vs._collection.get(where=where, include=["documents", "metadatas"])
        return [
            Document(id=i, page_content=d, metadata=m)
            for i, d, m in zip(r["ids"], r["documents"], r["metadatas"])
        ]

    def list_all(self) -> list[Document]:
        r = self._vs._collection.get(include=["documents", "metadatas"])
        return [
            Document(id=i, page_content=d, metadata=m)
            for i, d, m in zip(r["ids"], r["documents"], r["metadatas"])
        ]
```

```python name=project-3-rag-pipeline/main.py
    Document(id="p09", page_content="RAG retrieves external knowledge to ground LLM responses and reduce hallucination.", metadata={"domain": "rag", "author": "bob", "year": 2020, "cited_by": 7000, "rating": 4.6, "level": "intermediate", "journal": "NeurIPS"}),

]

def build_rag_chain(store: DocumentStore, filter: dict = None):
    """Build a RAG chain with optional metadata pre-filter on the retriever."""
    retriever = store.get_retriever(
        search_type="mmr",
        k=3,
        fetch_k=9,
        lambda_mult=0.6,
        filter=filter,
    )
    prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template("""
You are a helpful AI research assistant. Answer the question based ONLY on the provided context.
If the answer is not in the context, say "I don't have enough information."

Context:
{context}

Question: {question}

Answer:""")

    def format_docs(docs):
        return "\n\n".join(
            f"[{d.metadata.get('domain','?').upper()}] {d.page_content}"
            for d in docs
        )

    chain = (
        {"context": retriever | format_docs, "question": RunnablePassthrough()}
        | prompt
        | llm
        | StrOutputParser()
    )
    return chain

if __name__ == "__main__":

    print("PROJECT 3: Full RAG Pipeline + Metadata Filtering")

    store = DocumentStore()

    store.add(PAPERS)

    # ── Step 3: Update ─────────────────────────────────

        "p01",
        content="The attention mechanism in transformers computes weighted sums over all positions, enabling long-range dependency modeling.",
        metadata={"notes": "seminal paper — vaswani et al.", "reviewed": True},
        merge=True,
    )

    # ── Step 4: Upsert ─────────────────────────────────
    print("\n--- Step 4: Upsert ---")
    store.upsert(
        doc_id="p-new",
        content="Multimodal models process both text and images jointly using shared transformer architectures.",
        metadata={"domain": "llm", "author": "alice", "year": 2024, "cited_by": 2000, "rating": 4.5, "level": "advanced", "journal": "arXiv"},
    )

    # ── Step 5: All 9 Metadata Filter Patterns ─────────
    print("\n--- Step 5: All Metadata Filter Patterns ---")
    run_all_filter_patterns(store)

    # ── Step 6: Delete by ID ───────────────────────────
    print("\n\n--- Step 6: Delete by ID ---")
    store.delete(["p-new"])

    # ── Step 7: Bulk delete by metadata ───────────────
    print("\n--- Step 7: Bulk Delete (domain='tools') ---")
    store.delete_where({"domain": "tools"})  # nothing to delete, shows it gracefully
    print(f"  Remaining: {store.count()} documents")

    # ── Step 8: List filtered documents ───────────────
    print("\n--- Step 8: List All 'llm' Domain Docs ---")
    llm_docs = store.list_by_filter({"domain": "llm"})
    print(f"  Found {len(llm_docs)} LLM papers:")
    for d in llm_docs:
        print(f"    [{d.id}] year={d.metadata['year']} | {d.page_content[:60]}")

    # ── Step 9: RAG Chain (no filter) ─────────────────
    print("\n--- Step 9: RAG Chain (no filter) ---")
    chain = build_rag_chain(store)
    answer = chain.invoke("What techniques help language models reason better?")
    print(f"  Q: What techniques help language models reason better?")
    print(f"  A: {answer}")

    # ── Step 10: RAG Chain (with metadata filter) ──────
    print("\n--- Step 10: RAG Chain (domain='nlp' only) ---")
    chain_nlp = build_rag_chain(store, filter={"domain": "nlp"})
    answer = chain_nlp.invoke("How do transformers process text?")
    print(f"  Q: How do transformers process text?")

    # ── Step 11: RAG Chain (recent highly-cited papers) ─
```

```python name=00_theory/07_chroma_vs_faiss_comparison.py
"""
CHROMADB vs FAISS — Feature Comparison

┌─────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┐
│ Feature                 │ ChromaDB                 │ FAISS                    │
├─────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┤
│ Persistence             │ ✅ Built-in               │ Manual save_local()      │
│ Native metadata filter  │ ✅ $eq $gt $in $and $or   │ ❌ Post-filter in Python  │
│ where_document filter   │ ✅ $contains              │ ❌ No                     │
│ HTTP server mode        │ ✅ chromadb.HttpClient    │ ❌ No                     │
│ Multiple collections    │ ✅ named collections      │ One store per file       │
│ Upsert                  │ ✅ native upsert()        │ delete + re-add          │
│ Count()                 │ ✅ collection.count()     │ index.ntotal             │
│ peek()                  │ ✅ collection.peek()      │ ❌ No                     │
│ Raw vector speed        │ Good (HNSW)              │ ⚡ Excellent (optimized)  │
│ Large-scale (millions)  │ Good                     │ ⚡ Better (GPU support)   │
│ LangChain integration   │ langchain-chroma         │ langchain-community      │
│ Default embeddings      │ ✅ sentence-transformers  │ ❌ Must provide           │
│ Distance metrics        │ cosine, l2, ip           │ cosine, l2, ip           │
│ MMR search              │ ✅ (via LangChain)        │ ✅ (via LangChain)        │
└─────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┘

WHEN TO USE CHROMADB:
  ✅ Need metadata filtering natively
  ✅ Multiple collections in one DB
  ✅ Remote server/HTTP mode
  ✅ Simple setup with default embeddings
  ✅ Dev, prototyping, medium scale

WHEN TO USE FAISS:
  ✅ Maximum vector search speed
  ✅ Billions of vectors (GPU index)
  ✅ Already have embeddings pre-computed
  ✅ Simple use case, no metadata filtering needed
"""
```

## 🔑 ChromaDB Operator Quick Reference

| Operator | Syntax | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Equal | `{"field": "val"}` or `{"field": {"$eq": "val"}}` | `{"domain": "nlp"}` |
| Not equal | `{"field": {"$ne": "val"}}` | `{"level": {"$ne": "beginner"}}` |
| Greater than | `{"field": {"$gt": n}}` | `{"year": {"$gt": 2022}}` |
| Greater/equal | `{"field": {"$gte": n}}` | `{"rating": {"$gte": 4.5}}` |
| Less than | `{"field": {"$lt": n}}` | `{"price": {"$lt": 100}}` |
| Less/equal | `{"field": {"$lte": n}}` | `{"cited_by": {"$lte": 1000}}` |
| In list | `{"field": {"$in": [...]}}` | `{"domain": {"$in": ["nlp","llm"]}}` |
| Not in list | `{"field": {"$nin": [...]}}` | `{"author": {"$nin": ["alice"]}}` |
| Logical AND | `{"$and": [{...}, {...}]}` | `{"$and": [{"year": {"$gte": 2022}}, {"level": "advanced"}]}` |
| Logical OR | `{"$or": [{...}, {...}]}` | `{"$or": [{"domain": "nlp"}, {"domain": "cv"}]}` |
| Text contains | `where_document={"$contains": "word"}` | Native only |
| Text not contains | `where_document={"$not_contains": "word"}` | Native only |
